name: @dslzl/clsp
description: A Windows-first LSP companion for Codex CLI

scripts.check: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo test --all-targets --locked && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && bun run --cwd vscode check && bun run --cwd vscode test
scripts.clean: cargo clean && bun -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; for (const path of ['dist', 'vscode/out', 'vscode/clsp-ide.vsix']) rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true });"
